title: review (other model, opus): C-O4 fix round 2 on serve.py from review T-0155 (T-0158, executed by claude:sonnet)
spec: Review ONLY the T-0158 delta: `git diff 38db9bb HEAD` in worktree wt/T-0158 (orchestrator/serve.py, tests/test_serve.py). Fix round for review T-0155; confirm each item resolved: (1) every goals.* string that reaches a response body goes through the CREDENTIAL_RE redaction and a 300-char cap, full text only in the log (SECRET test); (2) MAX_BODY_BYTES enforced before buffering: Content-Length check first, then streaming with abort, request.body() no longer used on POST /goals (tests with an unread stream and a chunked over-limit body); (3) repos.toml read/parse guarded → 503 with /healthz still 200; the unfiltered fan-out isolates a failing repo as an error entry (tests); (4) cancel swallows ProcessLookupError/PermissionError → 200 stopped (test). Then confirm nothing regressed from T-0147/T-0153 (auth bytes compare → 401, per-slug lock spanning clone+check+start, clone stderr never in a body, 400/404/409/422 map, plain def handlers, module-attribute goals import). Run `uv run python -m unittest tests.test_serve -q` once. Verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments; keep to real defects. This is the third review of the serve endpoint: request changes only for a defect that matters in production.
acceptance: Verdict approve or request_changes with file:line comments
Each of the four T-0155 items confirmed resolved or named unresolved with evidence
No regression of the T-0147/T-0153 guarantees

comments.issue: T-0155 item 3 isolated per-repo read failures only in the unfiltered GET /goals fan-out (line 234). get_goal (249), cancel_goal (267) and the duplicate check in create_goal (193) call goals.status/stop/list_goals unguarded. goals._load_goal_records does json.loads(goals_path.read_text()) with no try, so a truncated or hand-edited .orchestrator/goals.json makes GET /goals return {"repo":"x","error":"unreadable"} while GET /goals/x/T-1 and POST /goals on the same repo return a bare 500. kgpt gets nothing actionable from the 500 and cannot tell a corrupt state file from a server bug. Wrap these three the same way the fan-out is wrapped (log + 503 or an "unreadable" reason).

Every handler is a plain def, so all of them run on the shared anyio threadpool (default 40 tokens). _with_repo_lock blocks its thread inside fcntl.flock for the whole critical section, which includes git clone bounded only by CLONE_TIMEOUT_S=300. 40 concurrent POSTs against one slug (or one slow clone plus a retrying caller) exhaust the limiter, and healthz — also sync — stops being scheduled, so the container health probe fails and the runtime restarts the process mid-clone, leaving a half-cloned path at cfg["path"] that the next request will not re-clone because os.path.isdir(path) is now true. Either take the lock non-blocking and return 409/503, or make healthz async so liveness cannot be starved.

_safe_reason redacts only the URL-embedded-credential shape (CREDENTIAL_RE = '://[^/@\s]+@') and then forwards the first 300 chars of an arbitrary goals.start refusal verbatim. goals.start reasons pass through _precheck_git, which can carry raw git stderr; a credential that is not in https://user:tok@host form — a GIT_ASKPASS echo, an 'Authentication failed' line quoting a PAT, or a token in a query string (?access_token=...) — reaches the 422 body unredacted. The cap limits volume, not sensitivity. Prefer an allowlist of known refusal reasons, or at minimum add the query-string and bare-token patterns.

subprocess.run(["git", "clone", git_url, path]) has no '--' separator, so a repos.toml git_url beginning with '-' is parsed by git as an option and an 'ext::sh -c ...' URL invokes a shell via git's ext transport. repos.toml is operator-controlled so this is not remotely reachable, but the fix is one token: ["git", "clone", "--", git_url, path].

_load_repos returns {} when repos.toml is absent, so a config volume that fails to mount makes every slug resolve to 404 'unknown repo' rather than the 503 that a malformed file now produces (T-0155 item 3). kgpt cannot distinguish 'this repo was removed from config' from 'the server has no config at all' and will treat a transient mount failure as a permanent deletion instead of retrying. Missing and malformed should both be 503.
